decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It uses control elements like Oblivion Stone, Relic of Progenitus, and Warping Wail to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also being able to tutor for specific answers with Karn, the Great Creator. The deck also has powerful threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine to close out the game. Jegantha, the Wellspring is included as a companion for additional value.

The deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent through small, aggressively costed creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, backed up by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike. The goal is to apply early pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Lightning Helix and Boros Charm provide additional reach and flexibility, while cards like Searing Blaze and Skullcrack help to keep control decks in check. The mana base allows for consistent access to the deck's red spells and enables smooth gameplay.

This Control deck focuses on powerful creatures like Elesh Norn and Omnath, paired with removal spells like Solitude and Prismatic Ending to control the board. Leyline Binding and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional control elements, while Wrenn and Six offer card advantage and recursion. The mana base is optimized for casting the deck's spells efficiently, with fetch lands and various dual lands. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win conditions through efficient removal and powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on using artifacts, specifically Urza, Lord High Artificer, to control the game by generating value and card advantage. It utilizes cards like Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek to create a steady stream of creatures while disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells like Spell Pierce and removal like Galvanic Blast. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support its color requirements and maximize the efficiency of Urza's Saga. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents to secure victory in a longer game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful creatures, removal spells, and disruptive planeswalkers. This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while ramping up its own mana base and building a strong board presence. The inclusion of cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Teferi, Time Raveler allows the player to control the tempo of the game and outvalue their opponent. The deck also includes versatile removal spells like Solitude and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats efficiently.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of creatures with different abilities to create a toolbox of options for different situations. It combines creature-based combo pieces like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide with sacrifice outlets like Zulaport Cutthroat and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons to generate value and disrupt opponents. The deck also includes tutor effects like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to access specific creatures when needed. Overall, the key concept is to assemble a versatile and powerful board state to overwhelm opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, focusing on fast and efficient plays. It utilizes cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's hand, while creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker put pressure on the board. The inclusion of cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Orcish Bowmasters helps to maintain a steady stream of threats. With removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push, along with protection from Feign Death and Undying Malice, this deck aims to maintain a strong board presence and quickly close out games. The inclusion of Blood Moon and Mount Doom can also disrupt the opponent's mana base, further tipping the scales in your favor.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive early plays and disruptive elements to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It combines hand disruption with efficient creature threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure from the start. Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker further disrupt the opponent's game plan while Undying Malice and Feign Death provide combat tricks to push through damage. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats, with a small Blood Moon package to disrupt non-basic lands.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, powerful planeswalkers, and versatile cards that can handle a variety of threats. It seeks to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage and maintaining board control. The inclusion of powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Wrenn and Six ensures that the deck can quickly close out the game once it has stabilized. The mana base is carefully crafted to provide the colors necessary to cast all spells efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful control spells and versatile creatures. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding to disrupt your opponent's strategy, as well as creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Solitude to apply pressure and maintain board presence, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent until victory is achieved. With a solid mana base and access to a variety of colors, the deck is able to adapt to different situations and threats efficiently.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach along with various artifacts and cards with graveyard recursion to quickly assemble a combo and win the game. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer help to generate card advantage and provide additional value. The goal is to loop through your deck, casting spells such as Thassa's Oracle or The One Ring to win the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler to help protect the combo and control the board.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with Cascade to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can cascade into powerful threats like Crashing Footfalls and Bonecrusher Giant. The inclusion of cards like Force of Negation and Blood Moon allows the deck to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining aggression. The mana base is optimized to support the Cascade mechanic and ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and capitalize on the advantage gained through Cascade.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the Colossus Hammer combo, using Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid to equip the hammer for free, enabling big damage swings early in the game. Stoneforge Mystic tutors for key pieces like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat, while Esper Sentinel provides card advantage and disruption. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to help find key artifacts and land disruption with Flooded Strand and Inkmoth Nexus to close out games quickly. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond.

The deck focuses on utilizing +1/+1 counters to quickly build up powerful creatures and overwhelm opponents. Cards like Hardened Scales and The Ozolith enhance the effectiveness of counters, while creatures like Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista benefit from having additional counters. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game, utilizing Urza's Saga to search for key artifacts like Inkmoth Nexus. With a mix of artifact creatures, counter synergies, and land acceleration, the deck seeks to establish a dominant board presence and close out the game swiftly.

The deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent using low-cost burn spells and efficient creatures. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of direct damage spells and aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The deck's mana base is designed to support the aggressive nature of the deck, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to the required colors of mana. The inclusion of cards like Roiling Vortex helps to disrupt opponent's strategies and prevent them from gaining life or stabilizing the board.

The deck focuses on using efficient creatures and cheap spells to apply constant pressure on the opponent while maintaining control over the game with counterspells and removal. It aims to quickly close out the game by utilizing powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Spell Pierce and Subtlety. The deck also includes ways to dig for key pieces with Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, allowing for versatile and proactive plays to secure victory.
